title: GroundGUI: GUI Grounding by High-Quality Data and Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constructing robust GUI agents relies on multimodal visual grounding: the ability to precisely map natural language intents to actionable on-screen components. Despite abundant desktop, web, and mobile benchmarks, high-fidelity resources tailored for diverse environments are surprisingly scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Screen Referring Grounding Dataset (ScreenRef), a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset consisting of GUI screenshots paired with natural language referring expressions and box or point annotations. Spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains, ScreenRef comprises 586K screenshots and over 633K referring expression instances, covering tasks such as text recognition, visual matching, spatial understanding, and refusal scenarios. To boost the model's grounding performance, we propose the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to address the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and the spar

translated_title: GroundGUI：基于高质量数据与蒸馏到强化学习的GUI视觉定位
translated_abstract: 构建强大的GUI智能体依赖于多模态视觉定位能力，即将自然语言意图精确映射到屏幕上可操作的组件。尽管桌面、网页和移动端的基准测试十分丰富，但针对多样化环境定制的高保真资源却出奇地稀缺。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了屏幕指代定位数据集（ScreenRef），这是一个全面的GUI定位数据集，由GUI截图与自然语言指代表达以及边界框或点标注配对组成。ScreenRef涵盖桌面、网页和移动端领域，包含586K张截图和超过633K个指代表达实例，涵盖文本识别、视觉匹配、空间理解和拒绝场景等任务。为了提升模型的定位性能，我们提出了蒸馏到强化学习（D2RL）方法，以解决监督微调泛化能力有限和强化学习稀疏（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了涵盖桌面、网页和移动端的大规模GUI定位数据集ScreenRef（包含586K张截图和633K个指代表达实例），并提出蒸馏到强化学习（D2RL）方法，以克服监督微调泛化能力有限的问题，显著提升GUI智能体的视觉定位能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ScreenRef, a comprehensive GUI grounding dataset spanning desktop, web, and mobile domains with 586K screenshots and 633K referring expression instances, and proposes the Distillation-to-Reinforcement Learning (D2RL) method to overcome the limited generalization of supervised fine-tuning and enhance GUI agents' visual grounding performance.
